purpose: Teach: ヴァン/タナ/サーキット/アロマ/ウルトラマン/エヴァ/ドス/ゴキブリ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヴァン・ヘイレンの代表曲を流してらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, Dad's got his Van Halen greatest hits playing again.
lines.style: Brisk affectionate report, faint eye-roll warmth about Dad's habits, light and quick.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと近所のタナさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mama, me and Daddy ran into Mr. Tana from the neighborhood!
lines.style: Soft eager burst, proud of the grown-up errand, bright rising ending.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがF1サーキットのドキュメンタリー観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, Dad's watching his F1 circuit documentary now.
lines.style: Amused over-the-shoulder tone, unhurried, small fond sigh folded around the title.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとアロマキャンドルを焚いたよ
lines.en: Mama, me and Daddy lit an aroma candle!
lines.style: Breathy delight, quick tumble of words, a little wonder lingering on the candle.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがウルトラマンの新作映画を観に行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho-kun, apparently Dad's going to see the new Ultraman movie.
lines.style: Light gossipy lift on the news, warm and brisk, gently amused close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとエヴァ、つまりエヴァンゲリオンの新劇場版観たよ
lines.en: Mama, I watched the new Eva movie with Daddy — the Evangelion one!
lines.style: Excited rush, tripping slightly over the long title, triumphant little landing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ドスの効いた一言で部屋が静まる」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, Dad claims one deep, growly word from him and the whole room goes quiet.
lines.style: Playful mock-serious quote of Dad, dropping low for the growl, laugh softening the finish.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとゴキブリ駆除スプレーを買いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mama, I went with Daddy to buy the cockroach spray!
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride in the mission, careful on the big word, satisfied ending.
